title: Central limit theorem for the homozygosity of the hierarchical Pitman-Yor process
summary: The hierarchical Pitman-Yor process is a discrete random measure used as a prior in Bayesian nonparametrics. It is motivated by the study of groups of clustered data exhibiting power law behavior. Our focus in this paper is on the Gaussian behavior of a family of statistics, namely the power sum symmetric polynomials for the vector of weights of the process, as the concentration parameters tend to infinity.
